description: `multiverse workers` makes one `agent list` call and renders the live, non-orchestrator agents it recognizes as this fleet's own (runner.dispatched_agents: a name of the form <project>-<role-short>-<seat-short>, both short codes resolved against the running config — 'expl'/'sb' here). The reply envelope mirrors the shape of the committed tests/fixtures/herdr/agent-list.json capture (same keys: agent/agent_status/cwd/name/pane_id under result.agents) with sandbox-safe values rather than that fixture's real host paths. It also makes one `pane read <pane> --lines 200` call per live agent with a pane id — card `20261115-b-59e017`'s stalled-pane content probe (crates/mv-cli/src/commands/workers.rs's `fetch_pane_hashes`/`STALL_CONTENT_LINES`) — whose reply content is irrelevant here, only that it is asked for.

home.config_toml:
[accounts.seat-b]
kind = "codex"
short = "sb"
config_dir_var = "CODEX_HOME"
config_dir = "{{DIR:codex-home}}"
pool = "codex:b"

[projects.sandbox]
path = "{{PROJECT:sandbox}}"

[projects.sandbox.chains]
explorer = ["seat-b"]

[roles.explorer]
write_scope = "none"
effort = "low"
on_exhausted = "degrade"
skills = []

[roles.explorer.models]
codex = "gpt-test"

expect.stdout:
PROJECT TASK ROLE  SEAT   STATUS  OUTCOME AGE
—       —    scout seat-b working —       —

workers 1/3
seats: seat-b 0
projects: sandbox 0 open, ceiling 3
nexus sessions 0 (excluded from workers; they do not count against max_concurrent)
